Theorem
[Hopf--Lax formula as solution] ↗ thm:hopf-lax-solves-hj-equation ↗ lem:hopf-lax-lipschitz-continuity 1. ch3:3.3-thm-6\group Hamilton-Jacobi Equations

The Hopf--Lax function is Lipschitz, differentiable almost everywhere, and solves \[ u_t+H(Du)=0\quad \text{a.e.},\qquad u(x,0)=g(x). \]
